findings.slide: Right or wrong? Check your predictions
findings.problem: This 2-minute student task is not in the SoW. The shared and plant-only answer key (membrane, nucleus, mitochondria, ER, ribosomes and Golgi shared) is taken from the Lesson 5 overview. The build_log logs both, but the slide asks students to mark stars against an answer the SoW never gives for Lesson 4. The SoW also says Lesson 3 covered animal cell ultrastructure when it did not.
findings.fix: Keep the slide only if the teacher agrees. Leave the logged flags for the SoW owner. Make clear in the notes that the shared and plant-only answers are teacher-checked, and consider using the filler time for the SoW's own wait times instead.

findings.problem: This is a new 2-minute written prediction task. The SoW's Model Building phase ends with a spoken close, and the 20-second wait time is also invented. It adds student work the SoW does not have.
findings.fix: Keep it only as an optional extension, or turn it into a spoken think-pair. Keep the SoW's verbatim closing line as the real ending. Remove the invented 20-second wait.

findings.problem: The notes tell the teacher to collect 5 sheets during annotation. The SoW collects them after peer-checking. If the sheets are taken before the swap, the peer check is disrupted. Students whose sheet was taken also lose the outline they need for 'Right or wrong?' and for Model Building.
findings.fix: Say 'scan 5 sheets in place and collect them after peer check'. Or collect the sheets only after the Peer check slide and return them before Explain.

findings.slide: Hero / Our maize farm in the Rift Valley
findings.problem: The hero image shows the gate, water tank and solar panels. These are three of the farm jobs students are meant to guess in Explain. If the hero is shown at the start, it pre-answers the analogy before the Predict phase. The deck adds this image; the SoW does not.
findings.fix: Show the hero only at the start of Explain, or choose a hero that does not show the analogy objects. Keep it hidden during Predict and Observe.

findings.slide: Driving Question Board: write your note
findings.problem: The Row A and Row B prompts on the student slide are 20 or more words each, with long sentences. They are heavy for a projected slide.
findings.fix: Shorten them on the slide, for example 'Row A: What does today help you understand about why cells look different?' and 'Row B: What new question do you have?'. Keep the full SoW wording in the notes.

findings.slide: Driving Question Board: post, read and vote
findings.problem: The notes add a 5-second wait before each vote. The SoW does not give this wait time.
findings.fix: Remove the invented wait time or mark it as a suggestion.

findings.problem: The SoW safety note says printed diagram sheets must have no sharp staples exposed. Only the projector cable reminder appears, in before_class and the micrograph notes.
findings.fix: Add 'check there are no exposed staples on printed sheets' to before_class and to the Job Card or outline handout notes.

findings.problem: The slide only lists three images as text. No micrograph files are in the resource list, so the teacher must find all three images (maize chloroplast, onion vacuole, cell wall boundary).
findings.fix: Say clearly in before_class that the teacher must supply the images, and keep the fallback. This is already logged in build_log.

findings.problem: For the SoW owner: the sub-strand number conflicts (1.1 vs 1.3). Lesson 3 is described as covering animal cell ultrastructure when it covers bacteria against cheek cells. The overview asks why plant and animal cells 'share the same DNA'. 'An electron micrograph is a photograph' is loosely worded. The SoW does not give smooth ER a farm job. The deck follows the SoW and logs each flag.
findings.fix: No deck change. Pass these flags to the SoW owner.

build_log.sow_says: Lesson plan header: 'Sub-Strand 1.1: Cell Structure'; unit data: 'Sub-Strand 1.3: Cell Structure and Specialisation'
build_log.deck_does: Uses 'Cell Structure' and does not show a sub-strand number on the phase slides.
build_log.why: The sub-strand number does not match between the lesson and the unit.

build_log.sow_says: 'A Form 1 student in Nairobi cuts their finger while slicing onions' (anchoring phenomenon)
build_log.deck_does: Slides say 'Amina' and 'Amina's cut finger', as the lesson plan does. The phrase 'Form 1' is not used.
build_log.why: The manual says never 'Form 1'; CBE uses 'Grade 10'. Amina is also not named in the phenomenon text.

build_log.sow_says: 'a star next to any you think it shares with the animal cell we studied last lesson'; SLO: 'animal cell ultrastructure covered in Lesson 3'; Model: 'Open to the page facing your animal cell model'
build_log.deck_does: Keeps the SoW wording on the slides and in notes.
build_log.why: Lesson 3 compares a bacterium with a cheek cell. Animal cell ultrastructure is taught in Lesson 5. The model in Lesson 2 is a generalised cell, not an animal cell. The L4 Predict and Model wording does not match the storyline.

build_log.sow_says: 'Allow 4 minutes of silent individual work — do NOT circulate yet' and 'Teacher scans written predictions during the 4-minute window. Flag any learner with a blank sheet'
build_log.deck_does: Notes tell the teacher to stay at the front and scan from there.
build_log.why: The SoW says both not to circulate and to scan sheets.

build_log.sow_says: Learner experience: 'observe silently for 90 seconds per image'; teacher moves: 'show each EM image for 60 seconds'
build_log.deck_does: Uses 60 seconds per image (3 minutes total). A 90-second look is used for the labelled diagram only.
build_log.why: The two times conflict. 60 seconds fits the 80-minute lesson.

build_log.sow_says: 'where a projector is available, the teacher also shows three electron micrograph images in sequence'
build_log.deck_does: Lists the three images on the slide as text. No image files are shown.
build_log.why: No electron micrographs are in the supplied resource list, and none may be invented. The teacher must supply them or use the fallback in the notes.

build_log.sow_says: 'a photograph taken with a beam of electrons, not light'
build_log.deck_does: Keeps the SoW wording in the teacher's notes.
build_log.why: An electron micrograph is an image made by detecting electrons. Calling it a photograph is loose wording, so the teacher should check it.

build_log.slide: Farm jobs 3: ER, ribosomes, Golgi apparatus
build_log.sow_says: SLO: 'endoplasmic reticulum (rough and smooth)'; table: 'Rough Endoplasmic Reticulum → ...'
build_log.deck_does: Labels the diagram 'endoplasmic reticulum' and uses only the rough ER farm job from the table.
build_log.why: The SoW lists rough and smooth ER but gives a farm job only for rough ER. Smooth ER has no job in the lesson.

build_log.sow_says: No times given for the show-of-hands poll and board record, building the farm table, triad discussion, DQB posting and reading, or the close of Model Building.
build_log.deck_does: Sets times: poll and record 3, farm table 18 in three parts, triad 3, DQB posting and vote 4, Model sentences 4 and next-lesson prediction 2. Timed tasks keep the SoW times: 4, 2, 90 s, 60 s, 8, 4, 4, 3.
build_log.why: The SoW's own times do not fill 80 minutes. No activity was cut.

build_log.slide: Right or wrong? Check your predictions
build_log.sow_says: 'Record class predictions in two columns on the board — SHARED / PLANT ONLY — and leave it visible throughout the lesson for revision.' No Explain step to mark predictions.
build_log.deck_does: Adds a 2-minute slide where students mark their predictions right or wrong in a different colour. The chloroplast star is settled after the triad talk.
build_log.why: The manual asks students to mark predictions in Explain. The SoW board record is for revision, so the slide uses it.

build_log.slide: Right or wrong? Check your predictions
build_log.sow_says: Lesson 4 gives no answer for which organelles are shared or plant only.
build_log.deck_does: The answer key says the shared organelles are cell membrane, nucleus, mitochondria, endoplasmic reticulum, ribosomes and Golgi apparatus. Plant only: cell wall, chloroplast and large central vacuole. This is in the notes only.
build_log.why: Taken from the Lesson 5 overview. It is needed to mark the Predict stars. Teacher to check, and see the sow_problem about Lesson 3 and Lesson 5.

build_log.slide: Why no chloroplasts in Amina's skin cells?
build_log.sow_says: Triads 'discuss' and the teacher cold-calls 2 learners. There is no written explanation.
build_log.deck_does: Adds oral sentence starters on the slide. No written task was added.
build_log.why: The manual wants a Claim–Evidence–Reasoning or sentence-starter ending. The SoW does not have one.

build_log.sow_says: 'a half-page handout with two columns: ORGANELLE and FARM JOB — all farm jobs listed, organelles blank'
build_log.deck_does: Shows the nine farm jobs as cards in a mixed order so students can write on their own handout.
build_log.why: A table of 9 rows is more than the 6-row limit. The mixed order keeps the same set of nine farm jobs.

build_log.slide: Driving Question Board: write your note
build_log.sow_says: Row A and Row B prompts; notes are sorted as 'growing understanding' or 'new mystery'
build_log.deck_does: Keeps the SoW prompts and the thumbs-up or question-mark vote. A reminder to use something seen today is in the notes.
build_log.why: The manual asks for evidence notes and questions in two colours. The SoW uses two prompts by row, so the SoW is followed.

build_log.sow_says: Version 2 is drawn on the facing page; no new colour or evidence citation is stated.
build_log.deck_does: Adds the starter 'This is based on evidence from …' and the SoW's early-finisher colour code (green and blue). No new colour pen is required.
build_log.why: The manual says to revise the model in a new colour each lesson and to cite evidence. The SoW does not say so.

build_log.slide: Model Building: Version 2 — The Plant Cell
build_log.sow_says: 'Allow 12 minutes for drawing and labelling' and 'After 10 minutes, prompt the summary sentences'
build_log.deck_does: Uses 9 minutes of drawing, 4 minutes for the two sentences and sharing, and 2 minutes for the Lesson 5 prediction (15 in total).
build_log.why: Fits the 80-minute lesson. Adds the one-sentence prediction for the next lesson that the manual asks for.

build_log.sow_says: 'No wet practical in this lesson. If a projector is used, ensure the power cable is secured... Printed diagram sheets should have no sharp staples exposed.'
build_log.deck_does: No Safety slide. The projector cable reminder is in the notes of the electron micrographs slide.
build_log.why: Not a hands-on practical or demonstration with materials.

build_log.slide: Model Building: Version 2 — The Plant Cell
build_log.sow_says: No ARES resources named in the lesson plan.
build_log.deck_does: Uses only model.reading (Plant Cell Structures, CK-12) as a reference icon on the Version 2 slide, as 'preview first'. No other resource is on a slide.
build_log.why: The other resources would show or compare structures before students record them, or belong to the glance slide. No placeholders or invented links were used.

build_log.sow_says: 'Learners receive a blank, unlabelled outline of a plant cell'; 'a half-page handout'; 'sticky notes'. No quantities are given.
build_log.deck_does: Materials list has no group quantities. Handouts are listed as one for each learner, as the SoW implies. No numbers were invented.
build_log.why: The SoW gives no quantities or group sizes for materials. A teacher should confirm what is needed for a large class.

build_log.sow_says: Overview: 'if all cells share the same DNA, why do plant cells have chloroplasts and animal cells do not?'
build_log.deck_does: This sentence is not on any slide. The deck uses only the Amina question: why do skin cells have no chloroplasts?
build_log.why: Plant and animal cells do not share the same DNA. Cells of one organism share DNA. The sentence mixes two different organisms and may cause a misconception.

build_log.sow_says: Purpose in storyline: 'In Lessons 1–3 learners anchored the phenomenon, explored cell theory, and mapped animal cell organelles.'
build_log.deck_does: So-far line uses the lesson overviews: the healing cut, what a cell is, and bacteria compared with cheek cells.
build_log.why: Lesson 3 compares a bacterium with a cheek cell. Animal cell organelles are taught in Lesson 5. The storyline and the Predict wording do not match. Flag for the SoW owner.

build_log.sow_says: No ARES resources are named in the lesson plan. Six resource keys are supplied.
build_log.deck_does: Only model.reading is on a slide (preview first). predict.video, predict.reading and explain.video are marked do_not_use. observe.video, observe.reading and explain.reading are preview_first and not on any slide. No links were invented.
build_log.why: The Predict and Explain comparison resources would spoil the predictions or the Lesson 5 comparison. The others are not exact matches and give labels.

build_log.sow_says: Lesson titles such as 'Microscopy Practical 2 — Human Cheek Cells: Observing Animal Cell Structure' and 'Consolidation, DQB Closure, and Final Explanation — The Healing Cut Fully Explained'
build_log.deck_does: Unit map titles are short parts of each SoW title, at most 6 words, for example 'Human Cheek Cells' and 'Final Explanation'. Lesson 8 shows 'Specialised Animal Cells'.
build_log.why: Titles must fit on the unit map without inventing names. Teacher may prefer other short forms.

build_log.sow_says: Learning outcomes use: describe, distinguish, explain, prepare, appreciate. The lesson names no goals.
build_log.deck_does: Goals use 'Describe' (twice) and 'Explain'. The third goal is about the model. Key words avoid plant-only versus shared organelle names.
build_log.why: Goals and key words are shown before Predict, so they must not give away the shared and plant-only answers.

build_log.sow_says: Summary Table prompts give observed, learned and explained text. There is no time or teacher steps for this slide.
build_log.deck_does: Gives the Summary Table 2 minutes, to be done at the end or as homework. Answers follow the SoW's summaryTablePrompt wording.
build_log.why: The manual allows 2 minutes at most. The SoW has no step for it.
